# `kernel/time/FactConflictResolver.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/time/FactConflictResolver.js`

FactConflictResolver.js — detects and resolves conflicting live facts on the monotonic FactStore. Detection reuses the CSE constraint helpers (engine/state/facts/Constraints.js: validateFacts/atMostOne/ mutuallyExclusive) — no parallel constraint engine. Resolution tombstones losers via a caller-supplied preference; a constraint never repairs on its own (CSE law), so resolution here is an explicit, logged act.

## Classes

### `class FactConflictResolver`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(facts)` |  |
| `exclusivePredicate` | `exclusivePredicate(predicate)` | At most one live fact whose predicate matches (single source of truth). |
| `mutuallyExclusive` | `mutuallyExclusive(factA, factB)` | Two exact facts must never be live at once. |
| `addConstraint` | `addConstraint(c)` | Add a raw Constraints.js constraint object. |
| `detect` | `detect(phase = 'runtime')` | Detect violations against the current live projection. |
| `resolveByPredicate` | `resolveByPredicate(predicate, prefer)` | Resolve conflicts among live facts sharing a predicate: keep the fact `prefer` selects, tombstone the rest. Explicit and logged — never silent. |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
